text:
maria: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR to merge the metering tiers guide with the migration examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3985

sam: Thanks! can you add a short section showing the new header + example curl for SDK v2 consumers? folks keep asking about the exact header name.

alex: small nit — call out the burst-credit behavior under the tier table, people assume bursts reset per-minute. you can add this line: 'burst credits are consumed from the account pool and do not reset per-request'.

maria: yep will add both. thinking of this snippet for the curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  -H "X-Redwood-Usage: meter=v2;tier=pro" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-rt-large","input":"hello"}'
```

tj: ping on tests — can we include a tiny sample that asserts the meter header is parsed into the usage payload? even pseudo-code is fine for docs consumers.

maria: adding a Jest snippet under Migration > SDK examples: 
```js
// pseudo test to show header handling
expect(parseUsageHeader('meter=v2;tier=pro')).toEqual({meter: 'v2', tier: 'pro'})
```

alex: also add a sentence about 429 semantics: older clients that omit X-Redwood-Usage will be throttled by default tier and may see 429s; link to the quota dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/usage-dashboard (console link is stable)

sam: can we include a one-liner about cost attribution? e.g., 'billing tags are derived from tier + route name, see examples below' — that's what finance asked for.

maria: will add. ordering for the migration doc: 1) quick summary for product owners 2) exact header + curl/snippets 3) SDK code samples 4) dashboard mapping 5) FAQs for common 429/overage cases.

docs-bot: Reminder — docs PR check list: links validated, snippets runnable, cross-links to API ref present.

sam: thanks. i'll do a pass for wording after you push. :thumbsup:

maria: pushed an update with header examples and the burst-credit paragraph. left one TODO about the dashboards screenshot — can someone capture a small panel?

alex: i can grab a small panel and upload, will replace the placeholder.

tj: added a tiny unit test in the examples folder to show header parsing, referenced it in the doc.

maria: awesome — i'll squash and request review from @docs and @eng-platform. leaving open for any last-minute wording changes.

sam: LGTM from me for wording; finance should glance at the attribution blurb before merge.

maria: noted, tagging finance in the PR description. thanks all! :slightly_smiling_face:
